definitions.definition: w_eff = -1 - (1/3) d ln rho_4/d ln a

rho4.A_compact_coordinate_period: ASSUMPTION: the extra times are compact with a fixed coordinate period (closed time-like directions); rho_4 = E/(proper 3-volume) ~ E e^{-3 a4}
rho4.B_per_unit_extra_time_coordinate_volume: non-compact extra times; rho_4 = E/(proper 3-volume x extra-time coordinate volume) ~ E e^{-3 a4}
rho4.C_per_unit_proper_7_volume: rho_4 = E/(proper 7-volume) x (constant) ~ E (equivalently per unit proper extra-time volume)

history: a4 = A H x4 PRESCRIBED (test field, no back-reaction); slices a4 in [0, 2]; a = e^{a4 - a4_today}

series.status: E = 0 and X = 0 at every slice (the k = 0 brane zero modes have eps = 0 and no interaction): no energy, w undefined

condensate.phantom_ratio_window: ratio < -1 iff -2 < u < -1 (attractive lambda S < 0; rho = m S (1 + u/2) > 0 iff m S > 0): an 8-dimensional phantom ratio is possible but constant
condensate.history: exact solution only on the linear member a4 = A H x4 + a0 (p3 = p_t forces a4'' = 0, Revision/field_equations_a4); the 3-space observer's expansion-inferred w_exp = -1 exactly

expansion_inferred.statement: on the history a4 = A H x4 used by the Kohn-Sham record (and the only history the exact condensate allows) the 3-space observer's Hubble rate a4' = A H is constant: the expansion itself reads as w_exp = -1 exactly, with no time variation; the Kohn-Sham states are not admissible sources of the a4 equations (Revision/field_equations_a4/reports/ks-source-conditions.json), so no self-consistent non-linear history is available (OPEN)

kohn_sham_gas.A_B: w_eff = X/E in [0.2929058677171, 0.3182941676741] (N = 688, lambda = 0): radiation-like, rising toward 1/3; no dark-energy value
kohn_sham_gas.C: w_eff = X/E - 1 in [-0.7071, -0.6719] (all gas series); tangent wa in [-0.0205, -0.0089], fitted wa in [-0.0304, -0.0181] (thawing sign, magnitude far below 0.60); w never near -0.861 or below -1; not the Unite values

unite_comparison.condensate: w_eff(A, B) = 0, w_eff(C) = -1, ratio u/(2 + u): all constant (wa = 0); the ratio can equal -0.764 (u = -382/441) but the observer's dilution-inferred w_eff is 0 or -1
unite_comparison.mixtures: gas + condensate: w moves toward the condensate's value as the gas redshifts (wa > 0, freezing) in every definition; the Unite thawing pair (wa = -0.60) is not reached (scan above)
unite_comparison.phantom: w_eff(C) < -1 or w_eff(A) < 0 needs (P3 - Pt)/E < 0; every computed state has P3 - Pt >= 0 and E > 0 except the N = 8, lambda > 0 states (E < 0, X = 0: w_eff = -1 or 0 exactly)
unite_comparison.label: INTERPRETATION (labelled): the comparison treats the Unite numbers as constraints on the dilution of a 4-dimensional effective density; the Kohn-Sham history is a prescribed background without back-reaction
